column1: # SDXL / Illustrious model set -- the 24GB profile.
# Format: <target path under /models>
# Tab-separated. Lines beginning with # are ignored.
# ~13 GB total. Do not pull this set on a 12GB card: Illustrious plus a ControlNet
# plus an IP-Adapter does not leave room for a co-resident LLM there. See
# docs/spike0-findings.md.
# Illustrious XL v2.0, the 2026 anime base. Booru-tag dialect like Counterfeit, so
# the prompt compiler is unchanged, but with far stronger prompt adherence --
# which is what the outfit and framing failures in Spike 0 came down to.
checkpoints/Illustrious-XL-v2.0.safetensors
# IP-Adapter Plus for SDXL. Reads through the same ViT-H encoder the SD1.5 set
# already uses, so clip_vision is shared between the two model sets.
ipadapter/ip-adapter-plus_sdxl_vit-h.safetensors
clip_vision/CLIP-ViT-H-14-laion2B-s32B-b79K.safetensors
# ControlNet OpenPose for SDXL. Takes pose and framing away from the prompt, which
# Spike 0 showed cannot carry them: with seed and anchor fixed, changing only the
# mood tag still moved the body, and sprites that differ in pose cannot crossfade.
controlnet/controlnet-openpose-sdxl-1.0.safetensors
# Native to ComfyUI as of PR #12747; needs the model file but no custom node.
background_removal/birefnet.safetensors
# SDPose, for ComfyUI's native SDPoseKeypointExtractor. Turns a reference image into
# a skeleton, which is how a pose slot is authored once and then reused by every
# expression in that set. The generic checkpoint cannot do this -- the extractor
# needs a model with a heatmap head.
checkpoints/sdpose_wholebody_fp16.safetensors
